query:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(impact:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(:Spec {specNumber:'38.211'}),
      (impact)-[:IMPACTS_SECTION]->(section:Section {sectionNumber:'8'})
WHERE section.sectionId STARTS WITH '38.211-'
RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber, impact.impactType AS impactType
ORDER BY impactType ASC, trNumber ASC
